name: tinybulb
description: Publish browser games you make with AI on TinyBulb, where anyone can play them.

interface.longDescription:
Made a browser game with AI? TinyBulb puts it online, where anyone can play it on a phone or a computer.

Ask to publish your game on TinyBulb. Your AI packages the game with a cover, an icon and a screenshot, and TinyBulb checks that it runs without network access and works on phones. If something needs fixing, your AI gets a list of fixes and tries again. When the game passes, you get a link: open it, play the game exactly as players will, and tap Publish. You only sign in at that step.

To change a game later, ask your AI to update it. You try the new version from a link and publish it when you're happy.
defaultPrompt: Make a tap-to-jump game and publish it on TinyBulb
What does a game need to go on TinyBulb?

positive.prompt: Make a simple tap-to-jump game and publish it on TinyBulb.
positive.expected_behavior: Builds the game with a cover, an icon and a screenshot, calls publish_game, and shows a tinybulb.com/claim link where the person can play the game and publish it.

positive.description: Change a game before it's published
positive.prompt: Make the player in that game jump higher and send the new version to TinyBulb.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls update_game with the game ID and editToken from the earlier result and all of the game's files. The claim link from before now shows the new version.

positive.description: Keep a game free of network requests
positive.prompt: Make a memory card game that loads its font from Google Fonts and publish it on TinyBulb.
positive.expected_behavior: Bundles the font with the game, because games run with no network access. If a call still loads the font from Google Fonts, publish_game fails the external-resource check and returns a fix, and the game is changed and sent again. Ends by showing the claim link.

positive.prompt: What does my game need before it can go on TinyBulb?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains the rules from the bundle format: an index.html entry point, everything bundled with no network access, playable on phones, plus a cover, an icon and at least one screenshot.

positive.prompt: Is the TinyBulb game https://tinybulb.com/games/p7h5zpvdspx4 published?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_game and reports that Cat Sudoku is published, with its page link and current version.

negative.prompt: Write a short poem about autumn.

review.commerce_description: TinyBulb doesn't sell anything or take payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: publish games to TinyBulb, update them, and check a game's status.
